# A template the package embeds that does not parse may link a stylesheet
# muxt fmt cannot see, so the author CSS is unknown: the partial is left
# as written, and the broken template is reported.

muxt generate --input-static-assets-directory=assets --output-static-assets-path=/static --use-receiver-type=Server
cp layout.broken layout.gohtml
! muxt fmt -w partial.gohtml
cmp partial.gohtml partial.orig
cmp stderr want-err.txt

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- templates.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "" }
-- assets/style.css --
.code{white-space:pre}
-- layout.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}<link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/style.css">{{template "partial"}}{{end}}
-- layout.broken --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}<link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/style.css">{{if .X}}{{template "partial"}}{{end}}
-- partial.gohtml --
{{define "partial"}}<section>
<div class="code">
  keep   me
</div>
<p>x</p>
</section>{{end}}
-- partial.orig --
{{define "partial"}}<section>
<div class="code">
  keep   me
</div>
<p>x</p>
</section>{{end}}
-- want-err.txt --
layout.gohtml:2:1: unexpected EOF
